title: Junior Backend Developer
description: Entry-level backend developer focused on core database querying, RESTful API design, layered architecture, basic caching, unit testing, and defensive input validation.

skills.rationale: Strong foundation in relational modeling, writing SQL queries, using ORMs, and executing migrations is essential for daily task delivery.
Building well-structured RESTful endpoints, DTO validation, and maintaining OpenAPI contracts is central to backend development.
Adhering to controller-service-repository layered patterns and applying dependency injection cleanly.
Writing reliable unit tests and database integration tests following the AAA pattern.
Applying secure password hashing (bcrypt/Argon2), verifying JWT claims, and writing parameterized SQL queries against SQLi.
Utilizing Redis for basic key-value caching with TTLs and managing background task queues.
Emitting structured JSON logs with correlation IDs and implementing /healthz readiness probes.
Designing stateless services for horizontal scaling, connection pool sizing, and retry backoff.

scoring.description: Each skill score is multiplied by its importance weight. Final score is sum divided by sum of weights.

not_ready.label: Not Ready
not_ready.description: Significant gaps in database querying, API fundamentals, or testing.

developing.label: Developing
developing.description: Basic understanding of CRUD endpoints, but needs guidance on SQL optimization, transactions, and layered architecture.

approaching.label: Approaching Ready
approaching.description: Solid database fundamentals, reliable API implementation, and consistent unit testing habits.

ready.label: Ready
ready.description: Meets all junior expectations: delivers secure, tested, well-structured backend endpoints with database migrations.

exceeds.label: Exceeds Expectations
exceeds.description: Exceeds junior expectations with early mid-level proficiency in caching, message queues, and indexing.
